lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 15 to 20 high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in three distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The middle row exhibits the most consistent spacing, forming a roughly equilateral triangular relationship between neighboring centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to create a grid-like structure. These intersections form high-contrast nodes, particularly evident in the mid-lateral section of the flank where the vertical bands are most defined.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light pixels on the dorsal surface to shadowed pixels on the lateral surface, extending from the gill region toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of an Echeneidae specimen (remora) attached to the dorsal-anterior region of the head, and multiple smaller organisms swimming in close proximity to the ventral boundary of the right pectoral fin.
